dedupe_keys.name: utility outage information doe 2015 white house mapathon power company service areas with links to public outage information

description: This Department of Energy dataset links each US power company's service area to where it publishes outage information, and is listed on data.gov through the National Renewable Energy Laboratory. The entry read on 2026-09-28 explains that during the 2015 White House Mapathon the department's Office of Electricity built a national geospatial database of utility service areas with pointers to public outage information such as websites, social media accounts and toll-free numbers, researched state by state so that residents, tourists, responders and relief volunteers could find restoration news after disasters, with app developers such as the Red Cross and The Weather Channel as users. Resources are a utility information export dated August 2015 as CSV, the 2013 service territory table from the Energy Information Administration's form 861 as a spreadsheet, and links to the EIA and OpenEI pages. Coverage is the United States. Access is free and listed as public; no licence is stated in the part read. Caveats: the contact links date from 2015 and many will have changed, and service territories follow the 2013 EIA survey. It supports emergency response studies, such as mapping which utility serves a hazard-affected county to match outages with restoration communications. Related record: the EAGLE-I county outage records.
